purpose: Cross-family Basic Five evaluation of downstream adaptation with the pretrained backbone and the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 task head trained end-to-end.
design_principle: Preserve the dataset, split, input, epoch count, task head, and metric of BASIC5_FAIR_v1. Unfreeze the backbone and change only optimizer, learning rate, weight decay, warmup, layer-wise learning-rate decay, and augmentation where full fine-tuning requires it.

global_rules.pretrained_weights: Initialize from the released pretrained checkpoint as-is; no intermediate task adaptation.
global_rules.normalization: Train affine parameters. For BatchNorm backbones, update running statistics during training and use them at evaluation; SyncBN is permitted when required by the effective batch.
trainable_scope: the same task head used by BASIC5_FAIR_v1
global_rules.head_invariance: Do not replace the baseline head with a stronger decoder. In particular, ADE20K and NYUv2 retain their 1x1 Conv heads and COCO retains Faster R-CNN/FPN.

feature_extraction.layer: Use the same canonical output feature/layer as BASIC5_FAIR_v1.
feature_extraction.spatial_tasks: Preserve the same token-to-grid conversion and feature scale selection as BASIC5_FAIR_v1.
feature_extraction.activation_checkpointing: Allowed as a memory-only implementation detail.
feature_extraction.feature_cache: Forbidden because the backbone is trainable.

global_rules.hyperparameter_policy: One canonical recipe per task, applied unchanged to every backbone. No model-specific learning-rate, layer-decay, augmentation, or feature-layer sweep.

lr_group_rules.layer_decay_definition: Starting at the head/output side with multiplier 1.0, multiply the learning rate by the task's layer_decay once per successively earlier backbone block. Embeddings/stem receive the smallest multiplier.

global_rules.precision: AMP/bfloat16 permitted; keep numerically sensitive losses and metrics in float32.

input.train: random resized crop to 224, scale [0.08, 1.0], ratio [0.75, 1.3333], random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 256, center crop 224
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

imagenet1k.feature_and_pooling: Use the backbone's canonical final global representation (for example CLS token or global average pooling), exactly as selected in BASIC5_FAIR_v1.
imagenet1k.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 linear 1000-class classifier
imagenet1k.loss: soft-target cross entropy when Mixup/CutMix is active; label-smoothed cross entropy otherwise
imagenet1k.minimal_deviation_note: The 100 epochs, split, resolution, pooling choice, classifier, and metrics are retained. AdamW, lower scaled LR, weight decay, layer decay, warmup, and regularizing augmentation are the full-fine-tuning changes.

coco.task: full fine-tuning with Faster R-CNN object detection

input.train: random horizontal flip p=0.5; resize shorter side to 800 while limiting longer side to 1333
input.evaluation: resize shorter side to 800 while limiting longer side to 1333
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

coco.feature_and_pooling: Use the same spatial/multiscale backbone features and FPN mapping as BASIC5_FAIR_v1; never globally pool.
coco.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 Faster R-CNN detector, including unchanged FPN, RPN, RoIAlign, box classifier, and box regressor
coco.trainable_scope: entire backbone, FPN, RPN, and RoI heads

optimization.schedule: step decay by 0.1 at epochs 8 and 11

coco.augmentation: Scale resize and horizontal flip only, identical to the frozen-linear baseline.
coco.loss: standard Faster R-CNN RPN and RoI classification/regression losses
coco.minimal_deviation_note: COCO already has a standard end-to-end 1x recipe. The detector, optimizer, LR, schedule, augmentation, and metrics are unchanged; the sole protocol change is unfreezing the backbone and its normalization.

input.train: random resize scale [0.5, 2.0], random 224x224 crop, random horizontal flip p=0.5
input.evaluation: single-scale 224x224 evaluation using the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 resize/crop policy
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

ade20k.feature_and_pooling: Reshape the same final-layer patch tokens to their 2-D grid, apply the unchanged 1x1 Conv, and bilinearly upsample logits with align_corners=false.
ade20k.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 1x1 Conv with 150 outputs; no UPerNet, FPN, auxiliary decoder, or multilevel fusion
ade20k.augmentation: Retain the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 random scale/crop/flip policy; add color jitter 0.4 only as regularization for full fine-tuning.
ade20k.loss: pixel-wise cross entropy with ignore_index=255 and no auxiliary decoder loss
ade20k.minimal_deviation_note: The 20 epochs, 224 input, final feature, 1x1 head, upsampling, loss, and metric remain fixed. Only the backbone is unfrozen and the low-LR AdamW/layer-decay recipe plus mild color jitter is introduced.

nyuv2.task: full fine-tuning for monocular depth regression
nyuv2.split: official Eigen-style 795 train / 654 test from labeled.mat and splits.mat

input.train: resize/crop to 224x224, random horizontal flip p=0.5, using the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 geometry
input.evaluation: deterministic 224x224 transform and the same valid-pixel mask as BASIC5_FAIR_v1
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

nyuv2.feature_and_pooling: Reshape the same final-layer patch tokens to their 2-D grid, apply the unchanged 1x1 depth head, and bilinearly upsample with align_corners=false.
nyuv2.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 single-channel 1x1 Conv depth head with positive depth parameterization; no DPT or multiscale decoder
nyuv2.augmentation: Retain the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 geometry; add color jitter 0.2. Do not use Mixup, CutMix, or synthetic depth data.
nyuv2.loss: the same valid-pixel scale-invariant log-depth loss as BASIC5_FAIR_v1
nyuv2.minimal_deviation_note: The official 795/654 split, 0.1-10 m mask, 30 epochs, 1x1 head, loss, and metrics remain fixed. A conservative low-LR AdamW/layer-decay recipe and mild color jitter address overfitting while the backbone is unfrozen.

input.temporal_sampling: one frame uniformly sampled from each of 16 equal temporal segments; random within segment for training, segment center for evaluation
input.train: per-frame random resized crop to 224 with temporally consistent parameters; horizontal flip disabled
input.evaluation: one temporal clip and one spatial center crop at 224
input.normalization: the pretrained backbone's published input normalization

ssv2.feature_and_pooling: Use the same backbone-specific temporal representation rule as BASIC5_FAIR_v1: temporal mean of per-frame global features for image backbones, or the canonical final global representation for native video backbones.
ssv2.head: the BASIC5_FAIR_v1 linear 174-class classifier

optimization.gradient_accumulation: use as needed to reach effective batch size 256

ssv2.loss: soft-target cross entropy when Mixup/CutMix is active; label-smoothed cross entropy otherwise
ssv2.minimal_deviation_note: The 16-frame sampling, 50 epochs, pooling rule, classifier, and single-view evaluation remain fixed. AdamW, lower LR, weight/layer decay, warmup, and standard video fine-tuning regularization are the necessary end-to-end changes.

reporting.checkpoint_rule: Use the final scheduled epoch for the canonical score. Do not select on the reported validation/test split. A best-validation checkpoint may be reported only as a clearly labeled secondary result when a separate validation split exists.
reporting.seed_aggregation: Report mean and standard deviation over seeds 0, 1, and 2; retain every per-seed result.
required_metadata: effective batch size and realized base/head/stem learning rates
per-seed metrics, mean, and standard deviation
peak accelerator memory and training compute
reporting.unsupported_rule: Report UNSUPPORTED with the reason; never replace a task, split, head, or feature type silently.
reporting.comparability_rule: Only results following this file without model-specific tuning belong in the BASIC5_FINETUNE_v1 main table.
reporting.oom_rule: Gradient accumulation, activation checkpointing, and parameter/FSDP sharding may change memory use but not the effective batch, realized LR, precision, number of views, or optimization semantics.
reporting.failure_rule: Do not tune a single failing model. Apply a protocol-wide numerical fix to every model, increment the protocol version, and disclose it.

optional_tracks.native_resolution: Allowed only as BASIC5_FINETUNE_NATIVE_v1 and must not be mixed into the canonical table.
optional_tracks.coco_2x: 24-epoch COCO results are optional and must be labeled 2x.
optional_tracks.strong_decoder: UPerNet, DPT, or other stronger dense decoders form a separate task-native track.
optional_tracks.ssv2_native_clip: Native clip length or multi-view testing is optional and must be reported separately.
